title: Anticancer efficacy of bis-heteroleptic iridium(III) complexes with difluoro-substituted phenylpyridine ligands
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22875-22888
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03076E, Paper

Suvasmita Behera, Kahnu Charan Pradhan, Sahadev Barik, Moloy Sarkar, Jagadish Kumar, Jagneshwar Dandapat, Jyotsnarani Pradhan, Satyanarayan Pal
Three cyclometallated Ir(III) complexes made of 2-(2,4-difluorophenyl)pyridine (F2ppy), along with pyridine-2-aldoxime and its two derivatives, were prepared and explored as anticancer agents against MDAMB, HT-29 and LN-229 cell lines.
